paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Thuman Louh Ziak A Gawtnate
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah, kuapeuh, Israel suante lak a mi hiam, Israel gam a teng gamdangmi hiam, agil a gah Molek pe peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Hiai gam a mi teng in suang in adenglum ding uhi.
english: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

paite: Ka mun siangthou leh ka min siangthou hihnin ding a, agilgah khenkhat Molek kiang a apiak ziak in huai mi tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia, achipihte lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
english: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

paite: Hiai gam a mite'n agil a gah Molek kiang a piak akitheihmohbawl ua, ahihlup kei uleh,
english: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,

paite: amah leh a-inkote tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia, Molek kiang a kei hon ang kawmsan peuhmahte toh achipihte uh lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
english: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

paite: "Alak ua angkawm dia dawi aisan siamte leh bumsiamte zuan mi tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia; achipihte lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
english: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.

paite: Huaiziak in kihihsiangthou unla, siangthou in om un. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a.
english: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Ka thupiakte pom in na zui ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA noute hon hihsiangthoupa ka hi.
english: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

paite: "Anu hiam, apa hiam hamsiat-khum peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Anu hiam, apa hiam hamsiatkhum ahi a, atung ah asisan moh a-om ding ahi.
english: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.

paite: "Mi zi angkawm, a-invengte zi angkawm zaw, a-angkawmpa leh a-angkawmnu, anih ua hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

paite: Apa zi kithuahpih in apa vuaktanna lem ahi a; hihlup tuaktuak ding ahi. Asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
english: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

paite: Mi'n amounu akithuahpihleh hihlup tuaktuak ding ahi. Tatsiatna tungtuan hih ahi ua, asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
english: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

paite: Mi'n numei akithuahpih bang a pasal akithuahpihleh thilkihhuai mahmah hihtuak ahi ua, hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
english: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

paite: Mi'n nuta zi in nei leh gitlouhna ahi. Na lak ua thulimlouhna a-omlouhna ding in amah leh nutate mei a hallup ding ahi.
english: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.

paite: Mi'n ganta akithuahpihleh hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Ganta leng hihlup ding ahi.
english: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

paite: Numei in ganta ava naih a, akithuahpihsakleh huai numei na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi. Ganta leng hihlup ngeingei ding ahi a; asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
english: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.

paite: "Mi'n asanggamnu, apa tanu hiam, anu tanu hiam akitenpih a, avuaktanna amuh a, ama'n leng avuaktanna amuhleh thil gilou hih ahi ua, amite mitmuh a satkhiak ding ahi uh. Asanggamnu vuaktanna lem ahi a, atatlekna moh apo ding hi.
english: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

paite: Mi'n numei akha teng si neih aneih lai a, akithuahpih a, avuaktanna alemleh asi pawtna lem ahi a, ama'n leng asi pawtna lem ahi a, achipihte ua pan anih ua satkhiak ding ahi.
english: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

paite: "Na nu sanggamnu hiam, na pa sanggamnu hiam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Asanggam nai vuaktanna lem ahi a, agitlouhna moh apo ding.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.

paite: Mi'n apaneu zi akithuahpihleh apaneu vuaktanna lem ahi a; akhelh moh uh apo ding ua, suan-le-pak bei in asi ding uh.
english: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.

paite: Mi'n a-unaupa zi akitenpihleh thilnin ahi a, a-unaupa vuaktanna lem ahi a, suan-le-pak nei lou in a-om ding uh.
english: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka thupiak tengteng, ka vaihawm tengteng na pom ding ua, na zui ding uh ahi. Huchi in tenna ding a ka hon pina gam in nou ahon lokhe kei ding hi.
english: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.

paite: Na ma ua ka delhkhiaksa namdangte thilhihte na zui ding uh ahi kei. Hiai thil tengteng ahih ua, huaiziak in, amau ka kih hi.
english: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

paite: Himahleh nou kiang ah, agam uh, nawitui leh khuaizu a luang gam, na luah ding un ka hon pe ding, ka chi khinta hi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, namdangte a pan hon hihtuampa ka hi.
english: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am Yahweh your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

paite: Huaiziak in sa siang leh siang lou leh vasa siang leh siang lou na khentuam ding ua; sa hiam, vasa hiam lei a vakthoh chi himhim hiam nou a dia siang lou dia ka sehtuamte in na hinna uh na kihhuaisak ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.

paite: Kei a ding in misiangthou na hi ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA lah ka siangthou ngal a. Kei a na hihna ding un namdangte lak a pan nou ka hon septuamta hi.
english: You shall be holy to me, for I, Yahweh, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

paite: "Pasal leng, numei leng dawi aisan siam zawl hiam, bumsiam hiam hihlup ngeingei ding ahi a; suang a denlup ding ahi uh. Asisan moh uh atung uah a-om ding hi," achi nawn lai hi.
english: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”
